name: As Commercial Industrial Company of Computers and Toys S.A.
summary: As Commercial Industrial Company of Computers and Toys S.A. manufactures, imports, and trades in toys for various ages in Greece and internationally. It offers approximately 1,500 game codes. The company also sells its products online. In addition, it is involved in the wholesale trade of toys and computers; and import of kids clothing. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Thessaloniki, Greece.
